title: Downloading at the same time
description:
Run several pretend downloads with `async` and `await`.

```
start a, b, c
b done (200 ms)
a done (300 ms)
c done (400 ms)
all done in about 400 ms
```
hints: `Task<string> a = Download("a", 300);` starts it without waiting (lesson 5.01).
To print each as it finishes, write the message inside `Download`, or use `Task.WhenAny` in a loop.
requirements: `async Task<string> Download(string name, int ms)` waits with `Task.Delay` and returns a message.
Start all three before awaiting any, then `await Task.WhenAll`.
stretch: Compare with awaiting each in turn, and print both times.
